visual_identity.core_identity: A huge crude giant humanoid whose enormous body, heavy limbs, and simple expression communicate brute strength.
visual_identity.silhouette: Very large broad torso, thick limbs, heavy belly, oversized hands and feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad heavy face, low brow, wide nose, large jaw, small eyes, simple coarse features.
visual_identity.body_shape: Massive thick-limbed humanoid with broad chest, heavy belly, and awkward giant proportions.
visual_identity.surface: Bare skin with sparse scars and simple folds; minimal texture.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw a massive heavy-bellied giant with blunt thick limbs and awkward proportions, not a sculpted bodybuilder; when architecture is present, its large scale must be proved by the surrounding human-sized structure.

accuracy_checks: ogre scale is obvious from body proportions
body is massive rather than lanky
pose can read awkward or clumsy
head is hornless and coarse rather than demonic
mass comes from heavy giant proportions, not sculpted superhero muscles

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
